transcript: Hello, and thank you for calling the information line for the lifeguard division for the city of Oceanside. Please choose from the following options for our weather and surf report. Please press 1. Good morning. The following Oceanside surf report was recorded on Sunday, November 15 at 08:15AM. Under some temporary clear skies, we got a five to seven foot southwest swell with fair shape. We got a water temperature of 74 degrees with a seven mile per hour wind blowing out of East Northeast. Today's tides include a high of 4.5 at 11:35 this morning, falling to a low at point seven at 08:03 tonight. If you like any further information on the Oceanside Lifeguard service, the tides, the swell, the surf, please dial (760) 435-4018. Thank you. Have a safe day. No one is available to take your call. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
